newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom's PacStar 6 mth loss NZ$22.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Telecom's PacStar 6 mth loss NZ$22.5 mln.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand on Thursday said its Australian subsidiary, Pacific Star Group, had recorded a loss of NZ$22.5 million for the half year to September 30, 1996, against a loss of $8.3 million for the same period last year.

Telecom said changes in the Australian trading environment suggested that Pacific Star "may no longer be the best strategic fit" for Telecom and the resolution of Pacific Star's future would occur within this fiscal year.
Telecom has a March 31 balance date.

"The review of Pacific Star's operations may result in all or some components being sold in the near future," Telecom said. Directors were unable to reliably estimate further losses (if any) which might arise from the potential sale or restructuring of the business or any part of it. Accordingly, no provision for further losses had been made.
"Telecom continues to see the Australian marketplace as an increasingly integrated one with long term growth prospects," Telecom said.
"Telecom has increased the size of its existing operation in Sydney, Australia with the immediate objective of further improving service to customers having trans-Tasman operations.
"Telecom also continues to explore other opportunities in the Australian marketplace."
